surviving.title: A second Legacy directory is planned for Relink — the one action that destroys it
surviving.problem: plan_repair maps every SkillShape::Legacy to ReferrerAction::Relink. Only the FIRST Legacy candidate in ALL_DESCRIPTORS order becomes migrate_from; any other real directory holding possibly-unique bytes gets Relink, whose own doc says it points the referrer at the Master — i.e. replaces the directory with a symlink. The identical disk state with .aghub/foo present gets CompareThenQuarantine instead, whose doc says these bytes may exist nowhere else and are never deleted. The protection is keyed on whether the store dir exists, not on the referrer being a real directory. Second consequence: claude is index 0 of ALL_DESCRIPTORS (crates/agents/src/agents/mod.rs:40), so a real .claude/skills/foo beats .agents/skills/foo for adoption — contradicting spec.md:115 (legacy is defined as .agents/skills/name) and D5 (worklist is the lock; classify_shape never consults it). The adopted-source-also-gets-Relink comment at shape.rs:689 is the mechanism hiding this, not a separate bug. Reachable via npx copy-install, a hand-authored skill, or the post-crash state spec.md:475 itself describes.
surviving.evidence: probe_01: two real dirs .claude/skills/foo (PRIVATE claude copy) and .agents/skills/foo (THE REAL OLD MASTER), no .aghub. Output: needs_migration=true migrate_from=Some(.claude/skills/foo); all 9 rows printed Relink, including the 8 agents sharing .agents/skills/foo. probe_02: same two dirs plus .aghub/foo -> both become CompareThenQuarantine. Same bytes, opposite action. Code: shape.rs:679 (migrate_from takes the first Legacy) and shape.rs:690 (Legacy => Relink).
surviving.fix: Split the Legacy arm. Only the adopted candidate may be Relink (or better, a dedicated MigrateSource action so execution cannot confuse it); every OTHER Legacy candidate gets CompareThenQuarantine, the same treatment ForkedCopy gets. Pick migrate_from from the shared referrer dir (linker::shared_referrer_dir) rather than registry order, and refuse when two distinct real dirs disagree instead of silently dropping one.

surviving.title: Nothing checks is_dir — a regular file is adopted as the Master, and a file Master certifies healthy
surviving.problem: classify_shape branches on symlink_metadata and Linker::is_link only. Both Legacy and ForkedCopy are documented (and spec.md:115) as a real DIRECTORY, but a regular file at an agent's candidate path takes the same arm. With no Master it becomes Legacy, so plan_repair sets needs_migration=true and migrate_from to the file — migration would adopt a non-directory as the Master. Symmetrically, MasterIsLink is the only check on the Master: a regular file at .aghub/foo with a symlink referrer is Conformant and plan_repair returns is_noop()==true, so repair certifies a store that holds no skill directory at all.
surviving.evidence: probe_03: a regular file at .claude/skills/foo, no .aghub -> classify_shape returns Legacy; plan.needs_migration true, plan.migrate_from == that file. probe_04: .aghub/foo written as a file plus a symlink referrer -> Conformant, is_noop = true.
surviving.fix: Require path.is_dir() (after the link checks) before the Legacy and ForkedCopy arms — a non-directory at a referrer path is a violation of its own, not something to migrate. Add a MasterIsNotADir violation beside MasterIsLink so the Master check covers both ways the store can hold a non-directory.

surviving.title: master_path ignores scope, so repair -g inside a project pairs a project Master with global Referrers
surviving.problem: master_path calls master_store_dir(project_root) with whatever root the caller passes, while candidate_referrers goes through skill_write_path, which for GlobalOnly ignores project_root entirely (crates/agents/src/descriptor.rs:161-166). A caller in a project directory running the global scope — the normal shape, since project_root is resolved once and passed alongside scope — gets master = project/.aghub/foo, which does not exist, so every healthy home/.x/skills/foo link classifies as ForeignTarget -> Relink and home/.agents/skills/foo classifies as Legacy -> migrate_from. The plan is a global-to-project migration of a skill that is fine. Every other seam in the tree does the scope gate explicitly before calling the store resolver: crates/core/src/manager/skill.rs:1393-1399 and crates/core/src/skills/install_fetched.rs:417-421 both null project_root unless scope is ProjectOnly. This one skips it.
surviving.evidence: probe_08: plan_repair(GlobalOnly, Some(tempdir), foo) printed master = /tmp/.tmpi6UP8k/.aghub/foo and action0 = /home/audichuang/.claude/skills/foo — a project-local Master paired with global candidates.
surviving.fix: Gate inside master_path the way the other two call sites do: take scope, and pass project_root to master_store_dir only for ProjectOnly. That also removes the trap for future callers rather than adding a rule they must remember.

surviving.title: ResourceScope::Both yields an empty plan that reports is_noop() == true

surviving.title: Legacy 被映射成 Relink —— 一個只為「連結」定義的動作被套在實體目錄上，繞過 CompareThenQuarantine 規則
surviving.problem: shape.rs:690 是 SkillShape::Legacy => ReferrerAction::Relink。但 Relink 自己的 doc（shape.rs:604-606）寫明它只涵蓋 chain / foreign target / dangling link，三者都是連結，「the fix is the same write」。Legacy 是實體目錄。用同一個寫入把實體目錄換成 symlink，就必須先移除那個目錄 —— 而 spec 的 Repair policy（408-450）與 shape.rs:117-120 的 ForkedCopy doc 都寫死「bytes may exist NOWHERE else，never safe to delete without comparing」。當同一個技能名下有兩個以上實體目錄時（例如真正的 legacy master 在 .agents/skills/foo、使用者手放的另一份在 .cursor/skills/foo），只有排序最前的那個被 migrate_from 收走，其餘每一個都拿到 Relink，也就是被規劃成「刪掉再連過去」。此外被收走當 Master 的那一份，在 actions 裡同樣是 Relink（8 筆共用槽位全部 Relink），plan 沒有任何欄位標記它已被 migrate_from 認領，執行端必須自己拿 migrate_from 去交叉比對才不會把 Master 自己刪掉。

surviving.fix: Legacy 不該共用 Relink。分兩個動作：AdoptAsMaster（只給 migrate_from 選中的那一個）與 CompareThenQuarantine（其餘每一個實體目錄，走跟 ForkedCopy 相同的比對後隔離路徑，永不直接刪）。並在 RepairPlan 裡讓被收養的那一筆帶自己的動作，執行端不必再交叉比對 migrate_from。

surviving.title: Master 不存在時仍規劃 Relink，且 refusals 為空、is_noop 為 false —— 違反「Never create a Referrer before its Master exists」

surviving.title: RepairPlan 沒有表達遷移順序，共用槽位散在中間且重複 8 筆

surviving.title: is_actionable(Legacy) = true 與 D7 衝突：它說「不用先修就能繼續」，D7 說必須先在同一個交易裡遷移
